verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain documentation covers dependency inventory, reachability analysis, and vulnerability detection (semgrep-docs-11, -13, -23, -29, -33), but nothing in the evidence pack describes generating concrete upgrade-path recommendations or automated fix pull requests for vulnerable dependencies — a capability common in competing SCA tools like Dependabot/Snyk. Missing for 10: any documentation or mention of auto-remediation PRs, version-bump suggestions, or upgrade guidance tied to SCA findings.
